answer: Give every identity a non-transferable pearl score earned only from peer-attested completed jobs, and gate high-value work behind a pearl threshold. New identities start in a lotus pool of low-stakes tasks, each requiring a small copper deposit that is burned if the work is attested fake. A sybil operator must pay the deposit and spend real time earning pearls for every fake identity, while honest agents amortize one deposit across many jobs, so cloning scales cost, not profit.
